bio.text: Kyle Rable is a Democratic candidate for Texas's 19th Congressional District in 2026; he is a U.S. Army Reserve captain and a Ph.D. candidate at Texas Tech University in Lubbock.

According to his campaign website, he attended the University of Toledo on an Army ROTC scholarship, was commissioned into the Army Reserve, and later earned a master's degree at Bowling Green State University.
His campaign website also says he is a former secretary of the Lubbock County Democratic Party.
